offer.title: Request this service

quote.title: Request a quote
quote.lead: Describe your need to the professional. Your request starts from your conversation with the shop.

quote.constraintsHint: Timing, approximate area, accessibility… Do not include a full address or phone number.

quote.attachmentsTruncated: Only your recent messages are listed.

quote.privacy: No name is added to this request: the shop already knows you through the conversation.
quote.refused: This quote request cannot be sent. Check that the conversation is still accepted.
